title: 第1464章 临别之礼第1463章 仙帝转世身
slug: 投资天命族人我实力是全族总和
content_zh:
做完这些后。
娲皇最后看了眼面前的身影。
“下一世……我会找到你的。”
话音刚落，身形便消失在原地，好似从来没有来过。
........
天墟界域。
转眼便到了第二日。
南方界群已有近半通道失去联系。
最初，那些魔族还以为只是天墟一方展开反攻。
可随着失效的通道越来越多，他们逐渐察觉到了不对。
“为何封闭的全是跨界通道？”
“对方似乎根本没有理会附近的我族据点。”
“有人在专门斩断我等与魔域之间的联系！”
这个猜测出现后，留守各处的魔帝立即向其他战场传递消息。
然而此时，姜道玄的力量已是越过南方界群，抵达东方界群。
第三日。
东方界群内的时空通道开始接连关闭。
第一条通道消失时，驻守其中的魔族并未过多在意。
可不到半日，又有数处据点与魔域断开联系。
一尊魔帝终于感到不安。

他试图通过尚且完好的通道，将消息传回魔域。
可消息刚刚送出，那条通道周围便泛起银白光芒。
“快稳住它！”
数尊魔帝同时出手。
可无论他们投入多少力量，都只能眼睁睁看着通道一点点收缩。
最终，那条通道在众目睽睽下闭合。
众魔站在原地，脸色难看无比。
到了这一步，他们脑海中都不由浮现出同一个人的名号。
“能够令我等联手都束手无策……莫非是那位太微天帝出手了？”
此言一出。
现场瞬间变得鸦雀无声，沉重压抑。
很快便到了第四日。
姜道玄所施展的时空之力蔓延至西方与北方界群。
越来越多的魔族战场失去后援。
原本正在等待援军的魔王与魔帝们，迟迟没有等到新的同族降临。
此时，来自其他界群的消息也陆续传来。
南方界群的大量通道失效。
东方界群同样如此。
如今，就连西方与北方界群都开始出现相同情况。
各处魔帝终于无法再将此事视作巧合。

有人正在沿着五方界群，逐一封印所有跨界通道。
而能够做到这种事情的人，整个天墟只有一个。
“是太微天帝……”
一尊魔帝望着眼前逐渐消失的通道，声音中满是颤意。
“他要将所有通道都封死！”
content_en:
After doing this.
Emperor Wa took one last look at the figure in front of him.
"Next life...I will find you."
As soon as he finished speaking, his figure disappeared from where he was, as if he had never been there.
........
Tianxu Realm.
The second day came in a blink of an eye.
Nearly half of the southern boundary group has lost contact.
At first, those demons thought that it was just the Tianxu side that was launching a counterattack.
But as more and more channels failed, they gradually realized something was wrong.
"Why are all the cross-border passages closed?"
"The other party seems to have paid no attention to the nearby stronghold of our clan."
"Someone is specifically cutting off the connection between us and the Demon Realm!"
After this speculation emerged, the Demon Emperor who stayed behind immediately sent the news to other battlefields.
However, at this time, Jiang Daoxuan's power had crossed the southern boundary group and reached the eastern boundary group.
The third day.
The time and space channels in the Eastern Realm Group began to close one after another.
When the first passage disappeared, the demons stationed in it didn't pay much attention.
But in less than half a day, several strongholds were disconnected from the Demon Realm.
A demon emperor finally felt uneasy.
He tried to send the news back to the Demon Realm through the still intact channel.
But as soon as the message was sent, a silvery white light glowed around the passage.
"Hurry and hold it steady!"
Several demon emperors took action at the same time.
But no matter how much effort they put in, they could only watch the passage shrink little by little.
Finally, the passage was closed in full view of everyone.
The demons stood there, their expressions extremely ugly.
At this point, they couldn't help but think of the same person's name.
"To be able to make us and others unable to do anything together... Could it be that the Taiwei Heavenly Emperor took action?"
As soon as this statement came out.
The scene instantly became silent and heavy and depressing.
The fourth day soon arrived.
The power of time and space exerted by Jiang Daoxuan spread to the western and northern boundary groups.
More and more demon battlefields are losing support.
The demon kings and demon emperors who were originally waiting for reinforcements have not waited for the arrival of their new kin.
At this time, news from other realm groups also came one after another.
A large number of channels in the southern boundary group failed.
The same is true for the Eastern Realm Group.
Now, even the western and northern boundary groups are beginning to experience the same situation.
Demon emperors everywhere finally could no longer regard this matter as a coincidence.
Someone is sealing all the cross-border passages one by one along the Five Directions Boundary Group.
There is only one person in Tianxu who can do such a thing.
"It's Emperor Taiwei..."
A demon emperor looked at the gradually disappearing passage in front of him, his voice full of trembling.
"He wants to seal all the passages!"
